requirements.requirement: The title, as of December 2023, of the book that satisfies all of the following conditions.
The book contains between 130 and 140 illustrations and descriptions of various objects, including the telephone and the telegraph.
The book provides a method for cleaning certain rusted objects using either a substance mentioned in a song by Three Dog Night or a type of oil that shares its name with a country song.
The book references a mechanical engineer born in the early 1800s.
The book references a scientist whose father was a poet.
The book references a well-known figure born in the early 1700s in a central European country, with the initials L. E.
